review: This tour offered excellent value for the price. The activities were fun, the group was great, and the guides made sure everyone felt comfortable, even if it was their first time in snowy conditions. Everything ran smoothly, and there was a good balance between adventure and free time. I'd definitely book another Natours trip after this experience.

Seeing the Northern Lights in person was something I'd wanted to do for years, and this tour made it happen. The guides were friendly, the itinerary was well planned, and we had plenty of opportunities to enjoy the scenery. The weather meant we had to wait a bit before the lights appeared, but when they finally did, it was absolutely worth it. I'd happily recommend this trip to anyone looking for a memorable winter adventure.

The Star Gazer exceeded every expectation. Watching the night sky from such a remote location was unforgettable, and the guides were incredibly knowledgeable about astronomy and the surrounding wildlife. The accommodation, meals, and overall organization were first-class from start to finish. It's definitely a premium experience, but every part of the trip felt worth the price. If you're looking for a unique adventure you'll remember for years, this tour delivers.
